nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and a family $F$ of subsets of $\{0, \dots, n - 1\}$, the number of comparable pairs of $F$ is the number of ordered pairs $(A, B)$ of members of $F$ with $A \subsetneq B$. It is the number of edges of the comparability graph $G_F$ on $F$, in which two distinct members are adjacent when one contains the other.
nodes.title: Number of comparable pairs

nodes.summary: For every real $\varepsilon > 0$ there is $N$ such that for every $n \ge N$, every family $F$ of subsets of $\{0, \dots, n - 1\}$ with $|F| \le (2 - \varepsilon) 2^{n/2}$ has fewer than $2^n$ comparable pairs, that is, ordered pairs $(A, B)$ of members of $F$ with $A \subsetneq B$.

nodes.title: Erdős Problem 777, first question

nodes.summary: For every real $\varepsilon > 0$ there is a real $\delta > 0$ such that for every $n$, every family $F$ of subsets of $\{0, \dots, n - 1\}$ with more than $|F|^{2 - \delta}$ comparable pairs (ordered pairs $(A, B)$ of members of $F$ with $A \subsetneq B$) satisfies $|F| < (2 + \varepsilon)^{n/2}$.

can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
